description: This file defines a static class LogFormatter within the Orleans.Runtime namespace, responsible for formatting log messages, dates, times, and exceptions for logging purposes. It includes methods for converting DateTime objects to string representations, parsing date strings, and printing detailed exception information with support for nested and loader exceptions.

classes.name: LogFormatter
classes.description: A static utility class for formatting various log-related data like dates, times, and exceptions.

methods.name: PrintDate
methods.description: Converts a DateTime object to a string in the specified date format for logging.

methods.name: ParseDate
methods.description: Parses a date string into a DateTime object based on the specified format.

methods.name: PrintTime
methods.description: Converts a DateTime object to a string in the specified time format.

methods.name: PrintException
methods.description: Converts an Exception object into a detailed string representation, including nested exceptions.

methods.name: SetExceptionDecoder
methods.description: Registers a custom decoder function for a specific exception type.
